sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What should your eyes follow closely when trying to catch a ball?
options: B) The movement of the ball
questions.answer: B) The movement of the ball

questions.question_text: Which part of the foot is best for accurately passing a soccer ball a short distance?
options: C) The inside of the foot
questions.answer: C) The inside of the foot

questions.question_text: When performing a forceful overhand throw, which foot should step forward?
options: B) The foot on the same side as your throwing arm
C) The foot opposite to your throwing arm
questions.answer: C) The foot opposite to your throwing arm

questions.question_text: What is the correct hand position to catch a ball coming above your waist?
options: B) Thumbs together forming a diamond
C) One hand in a fist
questions.answer: B) Thumbs together forming a diamond

questions.question_text: In badminton, what do you hit over the net with your racket?

options: A) Bouncing the ball with hands
B) Throwing the ball from out of bounds
C) Keeping the ball close while running using small kicks
D) Kicking the ball over the net
questions.answer: C) Keeping the ball close while running using small kicks

questions.question_text: To run faster in a straight line, how should your arms move?
options: A) Swing side to side across the chest
B) Swing straight back and forth
questions.answer: B) Swing straight back and forth

questions.question_text: Which action is an example of a striking skill?
options: C) Hitting a shuttlecock with a racket
questions.answer: C) Hitting a shuttlecock with a racket

questions.question_text: What is the safest way to receive and stop a fast-rolling ball?
options: A) Kick it as hard as you can back
C) Move your body in front of it and cushion it
D) Turn your back to it
questions.answer: C) Move your body in front of it and cushion it

questions.question_text: What is the 'ready position' in racket sports?
options: A) Sitting down waiting for the turn
B) Knees bent, racket up, watching the opponent
C) Standing completely straight with hands on hips
questions.answer: B) Knees bent, racket up, watching the opponent

questions.question_text: Describe how to perform an underhand throw accurately to a target. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stand facing the target, step forward with the opposite foot, swing your throwing arm straight back, and release the ball smoothly as your hand swings forward.

questions.question_text: Explain the proper hand shape for catching a ball below your waist. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your fingers spread and point your pinky fingers together to form a basket shape. Watch the ball closely into your open, relaxed hands.

questions.question_text: State the best way to kick a soccer ball accurately to a teammate. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Plant your non-kicking foot beside the ball, turn your kicking foot outward, and strike the middle of the ball with the inside of your foot.

questions.question_text: What is the ready position before striking a shuttlecock in badminton? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your feet shoulder-width apart, bend your knees slightly, and hold the racket up in front of your body while watching the shuttlecock closely.

questions.question_text: Why is the arm swing important while running short distances? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Swinging your arms back and forth quickly helps you keep your balance, creates forward momentum, and allows your legs to move faster and more powerfully.

questions.question_text: Imagine a ball is kicked high into the air towards you. Describe how you position your body to catch it safely. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would keep my eyes entirely on the falling ball and move my feet quickly to get directly underneath it. I would reach my arms up, make a large basket shape with my hands, and pull the ball into my chest upon catching.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are playing badminton. Describe the sequence of actions you take to hit the shuttlecock hard over the net. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would step back and raise my racket high behind my head. Keeping my eyes on the flying shuttlecock, I would swing my arm forward powerfully, step into the shot, and strike the shuttlecock right in the center of the racket strings.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete step-by-step action of throwing a ball overhand to a distant target. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, stand sideways to your target holding the ball near your ear. Next, point your non-throwing arm directly at the target. Then, step forward with your opposite foot, rotate your hips and shoulders, and whip your throwing arm forward. Finally, release the ball and follow through with your throwing hand.

questions.question_text: Describe how a player successfully receives a fast-rolling soccer ball and prepares to pass it again. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The player must stay light on their toes and watch the ball approach. They should position their body directly in the path of the ball. Using the inside of their foot, they gently cushion the ball to stop it closely. Then, they quickly look up to find an open teammate for the next pass.
